node.title: Re: determine the variable causing the error: Use of uninitialized value
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
$ perl -wMstrict -e 'my $myvar; print $myvar; printf "%s", $myvar' Use of uninitialized value $myvar in print at -e line 1. Use of uninitialized value $myvar in printf at -e line 1.

Could you show some code that demonstrates the problem ([id://1177642|SSCCE])? Also, which version of Perl are you using? Update: Just to be clear, by "the problem" I mean the variable name not showing up in the warning message. (Also, s/x/myvar/g)
